default.note: budget = min(0.30*window, 65536). Frontier-model knees are absolute (32k-128k, median 64k) regardless of a 1M nominal window; the fraction only bites on windows <= ~218k. Older models (NoLiMa/RULER) have effective lengths of 2-16k, so do not go above this for an unknown model.

_readme.strict: `ceiling` = lower edge of the CI-confirmed knee bin ÷ window (first bin >5 pts below short-context recall, confirmed by the 95% CI). The conservative number.
_readme.plateau: `plateau` = end of the flat region before the steep fall (e.g. 3.7 Flash holds 88–89% from 128k to 256k, then 78%). The permissive number.
_readme.use: budget.ts prints both; the experiment's provisional cap and D-010 decide which one governs. `default` applies to any model without an entry: min(ceiling×window, maxTokens).
